summary: The blueprint is broadly plausible for healthy human pancreas but needs targeted cleanup of a redundant exocrine axis, immune gate/label refinements, and modest missing-population coverage.

issues.description: The acinar-vs-ductal and ductal-vs-acinar axes are exact sign-reversed duplicates and add dimensionality without adding biological resolution.
issues.suggested_fix: Keep one acinar/ductal contrast axis and remove the reverse duplicate. If a ductal-positive dimension is desired, replace it with a plain or gated ductal/centroacinar program rather than the inverse contrast.

issues.description: The immune_core gate is myeloid/APC-biased rather than pan-leukocyte, which can suppress T, NK, and some B-cell gated axes. The t_nk_lymphocyte and b_plasma_cell labels also do not match their marker contents because NK and plasma cells are already separate modules.
issues.suggested_fix: Revise immune_core toward pan-leukocyte markers such as PTPRC, LCP1, CORO1A, CD53, LAPTM5, HCLS1, RAC2, and SRGN or similar. Rename or relabel the T and B modules/axes to match their marker sets, or adjust the marker sets if broader labels are intended.

issues.description: Resident dendritic/APC subsets are expected in human pancreas but are not cleanly represented; the macrophage_monocyte module does not adequately cover cDC-like cells.
issues.suggested_fix: Add an immune-gated dendritic-cell module/axis using supported human cDC/APC markers such as CD1C, FCER1A, CLEC10A, ITGAX, IRF8, and HLA-DRA, while avoiding duplication of macrophage markers.

issues.description: For all-cell-types healthy human pancreas, adipocytes or adipocyte-like fat cells can be part of whole-tissue samples, but no adipocyte program is represented.
issues.suggested_fix: If supported by the cited human pancreas atlas/literature resources, add a plain or stromal-scoped adipocyte axis with markers such as ADIPOQ, PLIN1, LPL, FABP4, CIDEC, and LEP or LIPE as appropriate.

out_of_scope: DOI, impact-factor, and citation-title verification were not checked in this discriminator pass.
